prompt:
Scene:
A square cinematic matte-painting style illustration of the same spaceport from the reference, now at night just at the moment of launch. Camera is low three-quarter angle matching the reference, but the sky is now deep indigo with stars and a crescent moon. Dramatic cinematic lighting from rocket exhaust glow and terminal neon.

Subject:
The same silver finned rocket with three cadmium-red stripes from the reference is lifting off its spiral gantry. A column of bright orange-yellow exhaust flame and turbulent cream smoke billows across the concrete launch apron. The art-deco spire terminal behind glows with warm ivory floodlights and its yellow neon observation dome ring is lit full strength. Small stylized figures behind a yellow safety rail raise hands to shield eyes; a hostess waves a chrome-handled signal wand. Reflections of orange flame wash the polished concrete pad.

Important details:
Rocket body, stripe placement, and fin silhouette must match the reference exactly. Terminal spire, observation dome, and gantry spiral must also match. Only lighting, sky, and exhaust change. Palette: indigo sky, ivory terminal, neon yellow, cadmium red stripes, chrome reflections, orange-yellow flame. Keep matte-painting illustration feel, not photoreal.

Use case:
Silver Rocket Terminal series shot 4 of 4, the dramatic launch moment of the same scene from the reference.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no modern rocket engines, no photoreal crowd, no glass-box modern architecture, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, preserve the reference rocket and terminal silhouettes.
